files.sdMissingBody: The device did not detect an SD card, so files cannot be managed. Insert one and refresh.
files.loadFailed: Could not read the file list
files.noProgramHint: The device has not assigned a program number to this file
files.deleteDesc: Permanently deletes the file from the device SD card. This cannot be undone (there is no recycle bin). Stop playback first if it is playing.
files.overwriteDesc: Already on the device: {{names}}. Continuing replaces them and cannot be undone.
files.switchModeTitle: Switch to Program mode and play?
files.switchModeDesc: The device is in “{{mode}}” mode and playback needs Program mode. Switching stops live forwarding.
files.nameEmpty: The file name cannot be empty
files.nameTooLong: The file name is too long (128 bytes max)
files.nameChars: The file name cannot contain path separators, .. or control characters
files.nameExt: The file name must end with .artrec

fw.unavailable: Firmware info is not available right now
fw.verified: The current firmware is confirmed valid
fw.pendingBody: It is confirmed automatically once the self-check passes, or you can confirm it now. Rebooting without confirming rolls back to the previous version.
fw.pickHint: Choose an application .bin (not a full flash image). The image header is checked first.
fw.warn: Upgrading reboots the device and interrupts playback and forwarding. Several devices are upgraded one at a time.
fw.confirmDesc: Writes {{version}} to: {{names}}. The devices reboot and playback and forwarding are interrupted. Do not cut power or the network meanwhile.
fw.failHint: The device usually still runs the old firmware, so you can retry.

dataDir.fallback: The application folder is not writable, so data is stored in: {{path}}. To keep data in the app's data folder, install the app in a location the current user can write to.
